script_text: Pisces, the cosmos is about to crack open a door you thought was sealed shut. Early week, your ruler Neptune in your 1st House squares Mercury in the 10th House on Monday, muddying career signals—avoid signed contracts Tuesday. By Wednesday, Venus sextiles Pluto from your 5th to 8th House, igniting a taboo romance and a surprise bonus from a client. Mid-week the turning point arrives as the Sun enters your 6th House Thursday, shifting focus to health and daily work. Late week, Mars trines Jupiter in your 2nd House Saturday, boosting income through bold action; Sunday soothes with Moon in your 12th. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Pluto awakening love. Monday is your worst day because Neptune squares Mercury clouding career judgment. Keep a dream journal to catch Neptune's messages. Follow for daily updates.
